info.title: TNIQ by Ringer — Customer API
info.description:
External API for TNIQ customers.

Provides endpoints for:
- **SOA Operations** — Port request lifecycle (activate, cancel, release, disconnect, conflict, IntraSP)
- **Number Inventory** — Search, reserve, assign, release, audit, and report on telephone numbers
- **Toll-Free** — Somos TFN Registry integration (search, reserve, activate PTR, disconnect)
- **Messaging / 10DLC** — TCR brand and campaign registration, CNP election, number assignment
- **CNAM** — Caller Name ID management
- **ROC** — Responsible Organization Change workflows
- **Reference Data** — Read-only CIC, NNID, credentialed Resp Org, and credentialed NPAC SPID directories
- **Port Projects** — Bulk port order management with CSV/Excel upload
- **Port-Out Releases** — NPAC release management

Authentication: Include your API token in the Authorization header:
`Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`

get.description: Machine-consumable feed over the activity journal (#365-2). Returns events with seq strictly greater than `since`, ascending, capped at `limit` (max 1000). Events younger than ~3s are withheld (commit-visibility grace) — poll again. `nextCursor` is the seq to pass as `since` on the next poll; idempotent by construction. While a long-running batch transaction (e.g. an inventory audit) is in flight, the cutoff is additionally held back to its start (#367) so its rows lag the feed instead of committing behind an already-served cursor; the holdback is capped (~30 min default), so consumers needing absolute completeness should still run a periodic reconciliation. A negative `since` is clamped to 0 and `nextCursor` echoes the clamped value.
